hero.description: Getmeds delivers precision pharmaceutical solutions and nationwide distribution — from regulatory compliance and government bidding to pioneering digital oncology care.

sectionDescription: Ten capabilities. Four focus areas. One complete pharmaceutical partner for Filipino patients, doctors, hospitals, pharmacies, and manufacturers.

focusAreas.label: Foundation
focusAreas.tagline: The global backbone behind every Getmeds medicine.
focusAreas.stats: 50+ manufacturers · 5 international standards · Full lifecycle regulatory management

services.title: Global Network of Pharma Manufacturers
services.description: Strategic sourcing partnerships with 50+ manufacturers across India, China, Europe, and the US — all WHO, PIC/S, US FDA, EU MHRA, and UK MHRA recognized. Every partner facility meets international quality standards, ensuring the medicines Filipino doctors prescribe and patients receive are backed by globally verified manufacturing.

services.title: Regulatory & Compliance
services.description: FDA Philippines, DOH, PDEA (S-4 and S-5), BOC, and EDPMS expertise across product registration, post-market compliance, and pharmacovigilance. Our regulatory team manages the full lifecycle — from Certificate of Product Registration application to license renewals — so partners can operate with confidence and speed.

focusAreas.label: Reach
focusAreas.tagline: How our medicines get to every corner of Filipino healthcare.
focusAreas.stats: 10,000+ pharmacies · 500+ hospitals · Nationwide reach · Government bidding expertise

services.title: Precision Supply Chain & Nationwide Distribution
services.description: WHO GSDP-compliant cold-chain logistics with batch-level traceability and urgent-response delivery across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Built for the urgency of Filipino healthcare, with specialized handling for biologics, oncology therapies, and specialty molecules.

services.title: Sales and Distribution
services.description: 10,000+ pharmacy accounts served through dedicated nationwide sales teams across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. Long-term partnership approach with account-managed service, product training, and market development support.

services.title: Government Bidding & Public Sector Access
services.description: Proven tender experience supplying oncology, hematology, and anesthesia medicines to public hospitals nationwide. Dedicated bidding specialists handle full documentation, compliance protocols, and competitive quotation preparation.

focusAreas.label: Who We Serve
focusAreas.tagline: The patients, doctors, and hospitals we're built for.
focusAreas.stats: 500+ hospitals · Filipino oncologists, hematologists, anesthesiologists · Compassionate access for rare disease patients

services.title: Hospital Partnerships & Institutional Supply
services.description: Trusted by 500+ Filipino hospitals across public and private healthcare — with dedicated account managers, cold-chain oncology handling, and urgent-response supply for ICU and critical care units. Formulary-ready documentation for hospital pharmacy committees and specialty procurement for hard-to-source therapies.

services.title: Doctor & Healthcare Professional Support
services.description: Partnership with Filipino oncologists, hematologists, anesthesiologists, and specialists across the country. Product education, clinical information, and Named-Patient Access Program coordination — because doctors succeed when their prescribed medicines actually reach their patients.

services.title: Direct-to-Patient Care & Access Programs
services.description: Prescription order fulfillment, refill support, affordable pricing, and nationwide delivery for Filipino patients. Patient Assistance Programs (PAP), Named-Patient Access Programs (NPAP), and Compassionate Special Permit (CSP) imports ensure continuous access to life-saving medicines — especially for oncology and rare disease treatments.

focusAreas.label: Programs & Access
focusAreas.tagline: Specialized services for government and pharmaceutical partners.
focusAreas.stats: DSWD · PCSO · OVP · OP accredited · CLIDP for pharmaceutical partners

services.title: Government Medical Assistance & Program Accreditation
services.description: Accredited chemotherapy and cancer medicine provider for DSWD, PCSO, Office of the Vice President (OVP), and Office of the President (OP) medical assistance programs. Fast quotations and streamlined guarantee letter processing ensure Filipino patients receive their medicines quickly and without administrative barriers.

services.title: Certificate of Listing of Identical Drug Product (CLIDP) Services
services.description: End-to-end CLIDP application, certification, and ongoing compliance management across our Certificate of Product Registration portfolio. Fast-track processing, low-risk market entry, and flexible minimum order quantities for pharmaceutical partners.
